segments.t: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you;
and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you
segments.note: 「in both of them」は ἐν αἷς（その手紙の中で）のほぐし

segments.t: that you should remember
segments.note: 主語・助動詞は英語の補い（μνησθῆναι は1節の διεγείρω にかかる）

segments.t: the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets
and the commandment of us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior,
segments.note: WEB は「us」（ἡμῶν）読みに従う。ギリシャ語本文は ὑμῶν（あなたがたの）

segments.t: knowing this first,
that in the last days mockers will come,
walking after their own lusts
and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming?
For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep,
all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.”
For they willfully forget
segments.note: 「willfully forget」は θέλοντας λανθάνει のほぐし

segments.t: that there were heavens from of old,
and an earth formed out of water and amid water by the word of God,
by which means
the world that existed then,
being overflowed with water, perished.
But the heavens that exist now and the earth,
by the same word have been stored up for fire,
being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
But don’t forget this one thing, beloved,
that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years,
and a thousand years as one day.
The Lord is not slow concerning his promise,
as some count slowness;
but he is patient with us,
segments.note: WEB は「us」（ἡμᾶς）読みに従う。ギリシャ語本文は ὑμᾶς（あなたがたへ）

segments.t: not wishing that anyone should perish,
but that all should come to repentance.
But the day of the Lord will come as a thief
in the night,
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「in the night」（ἐν νυκτί）を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない

segments.t: in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise,
and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat;
and the earth and the works that are in it
will be burned up.
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文の κατακαήσεται（焼き尽くされる）読みに従う。ギリシャ語本文の εὑρεθήσεται（24番）は「見出される」で、この訳語に対応しないため対応なし

segments.t: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this,
what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,
looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God,
which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved,
and the elements will melt with fervent heat?
But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth,
in which righteousness dwells.
Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things,
be diligent to be found
in peace,
without defect and blameless in his sight.
Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation;
even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,
as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things.
In those, there are some things that are hard to understand,
which the ignorant and unsettled twist, as they also do to the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.
You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand,
beware,
lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.
But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.
